therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: receptor agonism leading to pituitary desensitization and gonadotropin suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: ovarian suppression / gonadoprotection during cytotoxic therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Pediatric and adolescent female patients with childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus requiring cyclophosphamide therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Dose of triptorelin required to achieve and maintain ovarian suppression (μg/kg) over 24 weeks

results.effect_size: 120 μg/kg dose achieved ovarian suppression in triptorelin group; placebo did not achieve ovarian suppression
results.target_engagement_evidence: Suppressed LH levels used as marker of ovarian suppression; median time to suppression 18 days (95% CI: 15–25)
biomarker_changes: LH suppression achieved at median 18 days after initial triptorelin dose
Ovarian suppression not reached in placebo group
safety_signals: Serious adverse events in triptorelin group (n=25): peripheral oedema (1), neutropenia (1), neuropsychiatric lupus (1), infection (1), herpes zoster (2), gastroenteritis (1), diffuse vasculitis (1), cutaneous vasculitis (1)
Serious adverse events in placebo group (n=6): SLE flare (1), infection (1), hypertension (1), herpes zoster (1)

dose_info.dose: Starting dose escalated by 25% or at least 20 μg/kg per step; pooled effective dose 120 μg/kg; absolute max 7.8 mg
dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose escalation initiated if ovarian suppression not maintained; subsequent doses increased by 25% or at least 20 μg/kg until suppression maintained
